name: ask-marker-relay
description: Text-protocol question relay: ask marker steering, activation planning, parsing, and pending-question egress with a fail-loud raw fallback.
cardTemplate: Summarise the ask-marker-relay domain: marker detection is a capability independent of provider steering injection, and a question never disappears silently.
rationale: Detecting ask markers in a transcript and steering the model to emit them are separate capabilities. Codex has no session-scoped SkillInjector by design, so activation must be planned from provider identity plus Concordia availability, not from injector presence. When pending-question registration fails, the question is re-emitted as a raw ask block so it stays fail-loud instead of being dropped.
